spans.s: नैमंत्रणक n. A banquet, a feast.
नैमय m. A trader, a merchant.
नैमित्तिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Produced by or connected with any particular cause; 2. unusual, occasional, accidental.
नैमित्तिक (II) m. An astrologer, a prophet.
नैमित्तिक (III) n. 1. An effect, (op. to निमित्त ‘cause’), निमित्तनैमित्तिकयोरयं क्रमः Sak.vii.; 2. an occasional rite.
नैमित्तिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Produced by or connected with any particular cause; 2. unusual, occasional, accidental.
नैमिष (II) n. Name of a sacred forest celebrated as the residence of certain sages to whom Sauti related the Mahābhārata, R.xix.1.
